title: Glide 2.2.2 is here 🏎️
body:
⚡ Rebuilt efficiency scoring — your energy score is now four clear parts: acceleration, momentum & consistency, speed economy and energy recovery. Anything that can't be measured on a drive simply drops out and the rest re-balance, so city driving is no longer punished for never reaching highway speed. Descents count in your favour too, and the efficient cruising speed now adapts to the gradient.

🔍 New "Where did I lose points?" — open any trip, or your all-time stats, and see exactly which category cost you, in plain language: "120 of 125 accelerations were smooth", "Of 8 turns detected, 2 were harsh". Tap Efficiency to break it down further.

🗺️ Smarter map — tap anywhere along your route to read the speed you were doing there. Fast stretches that were genuinely efficient downhill are no longer flagged as wasteful, and sustained excessive speed now gets its own pin.

↩️ Corners measured properly — a new gyro-fused force reading holds through the whole turn instead of catching only the entry and exit, so long sweeping bends are graded on what you actually felt.

📊 Fairer averages — your all-time scores are now weighted by distance, so a real drive counts for more than a two-minute crawl. And a "harsh stop" warning that later gets ruled out now visibly retracts instead of standing.
